selector_utilisation_mr_s2.note: The oracle ceiling is DIAGNOSTIC. It is the score a label-aware chooser would reach over these recorded candidates and gets no deployment credit.

role_complementarity.reading: oracle_minus_best_single is the headroom differentiated roles create. If it is ~0 the roles are redundant however different their names are.

roles_did_different_things.note: A high identical count means the role prompts did not induce different operations on this backend, so an MR result cannot be attributed to differentiated reasoning.

s1_diagnostic.note: S1 withholds the derived checker findings on a prospectively fixed subset. Its calls are accounted separately below.

accounting.registered_reuse: one `direct` generation serves O, REP[0] and MR R0; identical checkpoint, prompt, decoding, limit and policy
accounting.note: The deduplicated count is what was spent; the logical count is what a deployment would pay. Reporting only one of them misleads in one direction or the other.

oracle_note: candidate-oracle accuracy in role_complementarity is diagnostic and gets no deployment credit
